profile.headline: Senior Software Developer/Manager | Platform Integrations | Payments, POS, Modernization
profile.summary: Senior-level Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience architecting and modernizing transactional systems across retail POS and healthcare domains. Expertise in payment processing, system scalability, and legacy modernization. Proven ability to lead technical strategy, design resilient systems, and mentor engineers while delivering secure, compliant, high-performance solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer/Manager
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• In the process of converting a legacy ISAM database to a relational database management system (RDBMS), originally estimated as a five-year project. Using AI-driven strategies, the updated plan is down to two years.
• Designed and implemented a C-structure record representation to optimize the relational table schema and developed a SHIM to minimize code rewrites, currently in integration and testing.
• Architected and led the evolution of retail POS systems, including redesign of payment processing workflows from Datacap to Verifone SCA Engage, defining abstraction layers to support multiple payment providers and future hardware integrations.
• Designed and implemented a multi-process enterprise file transfer architecture, isolating workloads per client database, reducing system latency by 40% and improving scalability under concurrent load.
• Led integration of WooCommerce API to enable omnichannel capabilities (curbside, online ordering), aligning POS workflows with eCommerce systems while maintaining usability for non-technical users.
• Engineered a unified build automation pipeline, migrating from fragmented batch scripts to a Python-based build system spanning MSVC, VB6, and .NET environments, significantly reducing build complexity and manual effort.
• Directed PA-DSS compliance initiatives, ensuring secure payment processing, audit readiness, and adherence to PCI standards across all transaction workflows.
• Mentored and guided developers from on-boarding through leading production features, including enabling a junior engineer to successfully deliver a new product line that opened a new retail vertical.
• Designed and automated database schema migration system integrated into installation workflows, eliminating manual update scripts and reducing deployment errors.
• Expanded hardware integration architecture using factory design patterns to support multiple scale devices (OPOS/Serial), enabling extensibility for future vendor integrations.
positions.insights: .NET Framework, Software Project Management and +16 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Developer/Manager
positions.description:
• Led architecture and development of Electronic Health Record (EHR) and practice management systems, designing scalable web-based solutions with ExtJS and WAMP stack to support long-term maintainability and cloud transition.
• Directed successful certification efforts for 2011 Meaningful Use under HITECH Act, ensuring full compliance with HIPAA requirements and federal healthcare standards.
• Designed and implemented real-time insurance eligibility verification system using SOAP-based integrations, reducing response times to ~30 seconds and improving patient payment accuracy to 95%.
• Developed internal ticketing and support platform, improving issue resolution efficiency by up to 90% and enabling structured tracking of production defects and support workflows.
• Engineered automated client update system with secure distribution, reducing support call volume by 30% and improving deployment reliability across customer environments.
Implemented real-time logging and monitoring capabilities, enabling detection and resolution of 85% of defects within 24 hours and reducing downtime by 60%.
• Integrated third-party payment processing into medical systems, reducing manual data entry and improving transaction accuracy.
• Mentored developers and contributed to hiring, on-boarding, and establishing development best practices across the development team.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant/Math Tutor
positions.description:
• Assisted Computer Lab Technician in computer setup and basic troubleshooting.
• Enrolled and Dropped students from classes through telephone or walk-ins. Distribute mail and messages to the appropriate faculty and staff members.
• Created and updated employee work schedules for the math tutoring lab.
• Assisted students in various math related courses. The courses consisted of basic and advanced mathematics up to college Algebra, Statistics and Calculus.

positions.title: Telephone Operator
positions.description:
• Assisted callers in placing local, long distance calls and international calls.
• Accepted emergency calls and direct to the appropriate authorities.
• Processed calls in a professional, efficient, and accurate manner.
